audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side read Skill on rows 0,1,5,6 while content win[] reads Zed, Zed, Zed, Viktor on those rows and the packet levelChart agrees with the content layer.
audit.why: Pre-augment Viktor has no Siphon Power shield up and loses the level 1-2 chip war; the first-item Youmuu's window is Zed's; a fully-augmented Viktor with Arcane Storm owns the two-item stage. Every why on those rows already argues the content-layer verdict except row 6, which is rewritten here to match Viktor.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and [1].side to Zed (win[N] already Zed, no-op avoided), phases[5].side to Zed, phases[6].side to Viktor with phases[6].why rewritten to the Viktor verdict; ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text used two fabricated ability names: "Death Ray" for E (really Hextech Ray) and "Chaos Storm" for R (really Arcane Storm), and called Gravity Field his R when it is his W.
audit.why: Riot kit: Q Siphon Power 600 range, 9/8/7/6/5, shield + empowered attack; W Gravity Field 800 range, 17/16/15/14/13, slow into stun; E Hextech Ray 525 range, 12/11/10/9/8, line damage; R Arcane Storm 700 range, 120/100/80. Passive Glorious Evolution augments abilities at 100 Hex Fragments.
audit.corrected: All spike, why, paragraph and wants text rebuilt on the real names, with the 9s shield timer and 17s Gravity Field as the concrete spike gates.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentioned that Siphon Power is an auto-attack reset, so the tell for his trade is the attack wind-up rather than the spell cast. It also never stated that the Siphon Power shield eats the Death Mark payoff tick.
audit.why: Riot text: Siphon Power "grants him a shield and empowers his next basic attack" (autoReset flagged in the kit). Death Mark repeats a portion of damage dealt during the 3 seconds, so a shield absorbing the burst reduces what the mark repeats.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, tradeBad and report[3].t: read the wind-up, and never commit the mark into a live 9-second shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint) and dosFull[2].d claimed a "fifteen-second invitation" with no source.
audit.why: Gravity Field is 17/16/15/14/13; Siphon Power 9/8/7/6/5; Living Shadow 20 at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into both fields at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets (dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string, dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string) under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles.

audit.why: The kit file carries the post-rework Viktor (Hex Fragments, Hextech Ray, Arcane Storm); the page text still carried pre-rework names. Nothing else patch-sensitive found on 26.15.

notes: Two fabricated names killed across the page: Viktor's E is Hextech Ray (not 'Death Ray') and his R is Arcane Storm (not 'Chaos Storm'); Gravity Field is his W, not his R, and spikes[1] had it labelled (R). Chart rows 0,1,5 moved to Zed and row 6 to Viktor to match content win[] and the packet levelChart; win[N] needed no edits (already correct), and phases[6].why was rewritten in the same proposal to argue the Viktor verdict. Kit flag note: Viktor's R carries a 'channel: interruptible' flag, but Riot's own text says the storm interrupts enemy channels and can be redirected — the flag looks like tooltip mis-parse, so nothing on the page asserts that CC cancels his ult.
